facts.text: S2S authentication generally available for Business Central automation APIs online version 17.0 and on-premises versions 18.11 and 19.5 and later.
S2S authentication generally available for Business Central APIs v1.0 and v2.0 online version 18.3 and on-premises versions 18.11 and 19.5 and later.
Service-to-service authentication uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow for integrations running without user interaction; supports scheduled tasks on version 21.2 and later.
Register Microsoft Entra application with unique name, specify supported account types, optionally add redirect URI for OAuthLanding.htm file.
Create client secret for registered application by selecting Certificates and secrets, New client secret, adding description, selecting duration, selecting Add.
Grant API.ReadWrite.All and Automation.ReadWrite.All permissions to Dynamics 365 Business Central API via API permissions, Add a permission, Microsoft APIs.
Set up Microsoft Entra application in Business Central by searching Microsoft Entra applications, selecting New, entering Client ID, Description, setting State to Enabled, assigning permissions.
Applications cannot be assigned SUPER permission set; use least-privilege principle and assign only required permissions for integration.
